AuraShare.DiehardHint: Should actors with "Diehard" continue to share auras when at 0 HP?
AuraShare.UnconsciousAurasHint: Should all actors continue to share auras when below 0 HP? (Overrides the Diehard setting)
AuraShare.DeleteAurasHint: Should auras be deleted when an actor is out of range? (If not, they get deactivated)
AuraShare.ShareZeroHint: Should auras be shared by an actor with exactly 0 HP? Disabling this will require -1 HP to disable the aura.
